sceneContracts.title: 점수는 무엇을 말해 줄까?
sceneContracts.spatialContract: Three projected plinths: quantity/evaluation, opponent baseline, calculation. Camera eases across their tops in the promised order, then first plinth comes forward.

sceneContracts.spatialContract: Two projected block towers share a floor. A score block rises while the line tower stays still, then a line block arrives; top/side faces and occlusion show independent changes.

sceneContracts.title: 같은 양, 다른 점수
sceneContracts.spatialContract: Equal-height teal line towers in front of different-height gold score towers; camera shifts to expose the hidden height difference without implying a scoring formula.

sceneContracts.title: 무엇을 높게 평가할까?
sceneContracts.spatialContract: Three distinguishable event tokens slide along separate spatial lanes to an evaluation gate. Unequal output heights are explicitly illustrative, not proprietary Tetris weights.

sceneContracts.title: 이번 행동과 누적 결과
sceneContracts.spatialContract: A small orange event token moves onto a retained score stack. The transient label fades while the stack stays; front/top/side faces show the contribution becoming part of the total.

sceneContracts.title: 누구와 비교한 숫자일까?
sceneContracts.spatialContract: Two score towers share an axis; a teal ruler spans their height difference. A second view aligns equal line towers. Show observed2920 and later141 as separate snapshots, not a computed win.

sceneContracts.title: 이름과 단위를 붙이기
sceneContracts.spatialContract: A projected tray of three counted objects becomes a named quantity; another score tower uses its own label. Rotate viewpoint to reveal the tops while labels remain screen-facing. Mark the invented objects as a design diagram.

sceneContracts.title: 계산을 읽는 순간
sceneContracts.spatialContract: Two spatial input stacks feed a multiplication bridge and a result stack. Use a labeled illustrative2×3=6, not a claimed transcription of the press clip. Orange contribution moves, count-up settles.

sceneContracts.title: 남아 있는 숫자와 지나가는 알림
sceneContracts.spatialContract: Persistent value stacks stay anchored on a floor while one orange event token enters from behind, rises, then exits. Two projection views visibly differ; a stable label never moves into the caption region.

sceneContracts.title: 세 가지 질문으로 점검하기
sceneContracts.spatialContract: Meaning, reference and readable change are three spatial gates. A labeled score token passes in order with occlusion and camera parallax, then settles beside the canonical coaching-link card above the caption safe area.
